In short, contrary to the tone of the Task Force Study and the Executive Order 11644 which seem to propose the accommodation of off-road recreational vehicles, the environmental statement draft presents a somewhat more negative approach, with a good deal less emphasis upon the needs to diligently pursue a scientific and organized program of land classification leading to fair land use.
I hope these comments have been helpful. Please do not fail to contact the American Motorcycle Association if additional information and dialogue is needed. We are at your service, and have a sincere desire to help with implementation of the Order.
Sincerely
Ed Youngblood
Associate Director
